title: Affine perfect extension after adjoining a shift
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a quasi-compact open of X, and let F be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there exists a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_X) whose restriction to U is isomorphic to F \oplus F[1].
